purpose: Matched non-autoregressive reference for M6: use the identical frozen codec, full-spatiotemporal DiT family, 3D RoPE, text encoder, flow objective, optimizer, sampler, and 100-frame task, but denoise the complete latent clip jointly with no clean-history prefix.

frozen_model.codec_checkpoint_and_latent_stats: record exact SHA256 after visual codec gate
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: not applicable; entire latent clip is noised and denoised jointly

validation.claim_limit: This is a matched small reference, not a reproduction of Wan or CogVideoX training scale.

final_evaluation.paired_noise_policy: materialize one complete latent-noise tensor per seed; R0 consumes it jointly and M6 consumes the identical tensor in temporal block slices
final_evaluation.compare_to: M6 v2 with the same frozen codec and full-ST backbone

extension_rule: Preserve 10k as the declared endpoint; any continuation is separately labelled and must keep the checkpoint-bound protocol unchanged.
